summary: Interpolation: the values x of −Λ(l') (reversed) followed by those of Λ(l) are strictly decreasing and within 6B of each other; Lagrange weights for these nodes give an orthonormal (for ε ⊕ 1) change of basis ω that is the identity on X and moves the last basis vector so that conjugation by ω carries diag(Λ(−l')) back to diag(Λ(l)) on the image of U(ε). The fields of IsTwoFactor are then checked one by one. (intro_lines 203–205 are not proof: they are the rest of the statement, lines 200–205 by the statement-boundary overlay of a second-reader message; the line census takes the `:=` of `let j :=` for the start of the value.)

steps.claim: o: x is strictly decreasing and |x_i − x_j| ≤ 6B for all i, j: the first block lies in [B, 3B] and decreases, the second lies in [−3B, −B] and decreases (IsSteep for l' and l).
Lagrange weights for the nodes x: c_k ≥ 1 with c_k² = (−1)^k∏_{j≠k}(x_k − x_j) (c1) and coeff_{2M}(P) = Σ_k (−1)^kP(x_k)/c_k² for every real polynomial P of degree ≤ 2M (hc).
